snippet.title: Astro Arena | Pre-register to Enter the Arena
snippet.description:
It's time. Pre-registration is officially open!👇
▶️https://uropa.go.link/fmiJo

Be among the first to step into a brand new casual 3vs3 PvP mobile game from PUBG Studios.
Pick your Hero. Build your skills. Battle your way through the Arena in matches that never play the same way twice.

🕹️ Pre-register now on Google Play and the App Store.
🚀 Launches July 9th.
🌏 Available in India, Indonesia, Thailand, Taiwan, Mexico, Brazil, and the United States.

For the latest news and updates on launch, join our Discord
▶️https://uropa.news/Discord

#AstroArena #PreRegistration #mobilepvp
